data.name: Arvind
data.gender_notes: Arvind is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arvind is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘arvindam’, meaning ‘with dark complexion and brave’. In Hindu mythology, Arvind is considered a form of Lord Indra, the god of rain, thunder, and lightning. This name is also associated with the brave warrior Arjuna in the Hindu epic Mahabharata. The name Arvind carries the meaning “Dark, Brave” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arvind usually hope their child will grow to embody dark, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
